question: How can such variegation exist within a nondual self?
premises: An objection has been raised about multiplicity within nondual bliss.
The answer appeals to the nature of the Lord of consciousness.
That Lord is unlimited in nature.
inference: The unlimited Lord of consciousness can contain variegation within himself without losing nonduality.
uncertainties: The verse functions as a transition into the explanation that follows.
plain_english: How can those two, free from division, take on such variegation within their own self? Listen: this Lord of consciousness is by nature unlimited.
